<p class="page-lede">The forty members of the Senate. Click a name for their record — bills, votes, and contributions received.</p>

```{r}
library(gt)
source("scripts/shared.R")

senators <- load_senators() |>
  mutate(display_name = paste(Last.Name, First.Name, sep = ", "))

# Profile PDFs exist once role profiles are posted; the column only
# appears when the folder has files. Filenames follow name_link:
# e.g. ochoa_bogh_19_profile.pdf
profiles_exist <- dir.exists(SEN_PROFILE_DIR) && length(list.files(SEN_PROFILE_DIR)) > 0

leadership_has_data <- "Leadership" %in% names(senators) &&
  any(!is.na(senators$Leadership) & senators$Leadership != "")

senators$Name_Link <- sprintf("[%s](%s/district_%s.html)",
                              senators$display_name, SENATOR_PAGES_DIR, senators$District)

markdown_columns <- c("Name_Link")
if (profiles_exist) {
  senators$Profile <- sprintf("[View Profile](%s/%s_%s_profile.pdf)",
                              SEN_PROFILE_DIR, senators$name_link, senators$District)
  markdown_columns <- c(markdown_columns, "Profile")
}

columns_to_show <- c("District", "Name_Link", "Party")
if (leadership_has_data) columns_to_show <- c(columns_to_show, "Leadership")
if (profiles_exist)      columns_to_show <- c(columns_to_show, "Profile")

senators |>
  select(all_of(columns_to_show)) |>
  gt() |>
  cols_label(
    District = "District",
    Name_Link = "Name",
    Party = "Party"
  ) |>
  cols_align(align = "left", columns = everything()) |>
  fmt_markdown(columns = all_of(markdown_columns)) |>
  opt_interactive(
    use_sorting = TRUE,
    use_search = TRUE,
    use_filters = FALSE,
    use_resizers = TRUE,
    page_size_default = 20
  ) |>
  opt_row_striping()
```
